name: black_morass
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 269 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json), fixed from the 2026-10-24 census of tools/dungeongen/testdata/map269 and ~/tortoise-wow/sql/base. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
Census: 330 spawns, 23 entries. The 28 Snakes (2914, faction 190, level 1, 9 hp, critter) are out of every pull (26 pure snake pulls gone). Max planned pack is 5 units.

Hostile trash is faction 40 (34, Escortee) except the Time Anomaly 50106 (faction 7, neutral but attackable) and the cave mobs 61316/61317/61318 (faction 16). None is humanoid: no Polymorph, so cc_priority/cc_always are empty and every trash entry is in no_cc. No trash script flees (no Flee/EventAI 47 anywhere in the instance), so fleers is empty.

Casters: 50106 Arcane Explosion (27989); 61316 Sand Blast (57103); 61317 Earth Shock (13281); 61318 Arcane Bolt (25055); 61575 Epidamu Drain Mana (17682); 65102 Riftweaver Time Stop (23171, 20 s) + Shadow Shock + Mind Blast; 65100 Dragonspawn Rend/Cleave; 65101 Riftguard charges a casting player within 50 yd (22911); 65103 Whelp drains 5 % max mana every 3 s from players within 20 yd and Arcane Explosions at full mana; 65105 Rift-Lord Whirlwind/Thunderclap/Demolishing Shout; 65110 Poison 24097; 65111 Wound 16549; 65112 Paralyzing Poison 3609. kill_first: 65124 Mossheart (Rejuvenation 20664 below 75 %, Entangling Roots, Dredge Sickness within 10 yd), 65102 (Time Stop), 65105 (Whirlwind), 61575 (Drain Mana).

Named scripted mobs in pulls, not bosses: Rotmaw 65122 (Consume roots itself and shrinks a player for 15.5 s, then Knockback; Mortal Wound/Sunder), Mossheart 65124 (stealths out of combat; Rejuv), Epidamu 61575 (Drain Mana). Boss rows: Antnormi 65125 (Thrash, Cowering Roar, Shadow Shock; Enrage at 20 % or 5 min), Medivh 50105 (FACTION 35: friendly to the party, no script, 1,024,000 hp; the run leader's boss step reads 'boss is friendly to this party: left alone' and the leg advances - the row is a destination marker, not a kill), Epochronos 65116 (Sand Breath, Swoop, Arcane Blast; at 50 % banishes itself and summons one Echo: Lich King 65117 / Kael'thas 65118 / Vashj 65119, which must die before it unbanishes), Chronar 65113 (Shout, Mortal Strike, Sweeping Slam, Spell Reflection, Enrage at 35 %).
The Time Anomaly 50106 at -1450.10 6967.23 -14.3097 stood 18.9 yd from Epochronos (detection 20): moved to the end of its leg, so the boss joins that one pull and not a mid-leg one.

Patrols with a creature_movement path: 65100 guid 2567942 (237 yd, ~95 s), 65101 2567943 (190 yd, ~76 s), 65101 2567944 (184 yd, ~74 s), 61318 2574761 (319 yd, ~128 s), 61318 2574775 (431 yd, ~172 s). Each group whose stand is within 25 yd of a path carries that patrol block (period is the path length at 2.5 yd/s: period_estimate). Mossheart 65124, Medivh 50105 and the Bronze Defenders 65126/65128 have movement_type 2 but no movement rows: no block can be written; the mapping walk measures them.

Floors: all pull stands are exact spawn rows and no pack spans |dz| > 6. The map is stacked: other hostile packs stand directly above/below many stands (50106/61317/61318 in the z -165..+56 cave column, 65100-65103 between -230 and -122). Aggro is 3-D, so they are not pull members, but the route between floors is the mapping walk's first item: seven approach hops could not be cut (leg 2 step 40; leg 3 steps 2, 15, 16, 28, 30 and the boss step 34; the nearest reachable point is up to 142.9 yd short). The 274 run-leader hop notices are the same walk.

Route: leg order antnormi -> medivh -> epochronos -> chronar is the shortest of the 24 permutations (7,852 yd from the entrance; the next best is +532). Within each leg the groups are ordered by a 3-D 2-opt from the leg's start to its boss (6,221->5,233, 1,649->1,406, 3,455->2,846 and 1,901->1,751 yd; the vertical travel also falls, 311->306, 661->442, 491->452).
The instance script teleports a player below z -281 back to the entrance; Epochronos' death removes the Sand Wall 2010865 (and a 180322 barrier within 75 yd). No door, lever or key is in the plan.
